title: Rap Pal Dot App
style: Clap-heavy boom-bap rap with crisp handclaps on the backbeat, swung hi-hats, and a punchy bass loop; verse rides sparse drums and cheeky talk-rap, pre-chorus pulls to claps and a filtered chant, chorus hits with stacked gang vocals and a call-and-response hook. Tight doubles on key lines, ad-lib pings on the hook words, clap fills and short tape-stop throws between phrases. Bright, dry, front-of-mix energy with playful snap., rap

Say it clear
rappal.app

Say it with me
Don’t make me wait
You got that?
Say it straight
